result.summary: A dark-themed chat or agent composer widget with rounded borders. The top area contains placeholder text instructing the user to type a task and press Enter. The bottom row contains, from left to right, a plus icon, a red dot with 'Full Access' dropdown, an '@ Agent' dropdown, and a blue dotted icon with 'Type a model ...' dropdown. The widget has no visible send button, no inner divider, and generous spacing between the left controls. No text appears truncated or clipped.
